Products

Everything a transformer OEM or utility workshop needs for the insulation inside the tank. Every item is made to order.

Pressboard Strips

Electrical-grade pressboard strips cut to size for transformer windings and clamping.

Dovetail Spacers

Pressboard dovetail spacers for pressure rings, static rings and winding ducts.

Hardwood Rods for Transformers

Seasoned hardwood rods, 6 mm to 16 mm diameter, up to 2 metres long.

Transformer Insulation Kit

A complete set of pressboard insulation parts for one transformer, ready to fit.

Bakelite Strips (Phenolic Laminate)

F4 electrical-grade phenolic laminated strips, cotton or paper base.

Permawood Components

Permawood / transformer-wood parts machined exactly to your drawing.

Clack Bands

Lightweight press-paper clack bands for power transformer windings.

Why transformer makers buy from us

Made to your drawing

Send a drawing or a sample. We cut strips, spacers and components to the exact size, in trial lots or regular supply.

Electrical-grade materials

Transformer-grade pressboard, F4 phenolic laminate, seasoned hardwood and Permawood, chosen for oil and heat.

Complete kits

Order one insulation kit per transformer and get every part cut, labelled and packed together.

Direct from the factory

You deal with the manufacturer, which keeps prices competitive and lead times short. GST invoices on every order.

Who we supply

Transformer manufacturers building distribution and power transformers, and state electricity boards that maintain and rewind their own units. Jhansi sits on the Delhi–Mumbai and Delhi–Chennai corridors, so most of north, central and west India is two to four days away by road.
